title: The plant's scripted input schedule runs on PLC virtual time: a 2 s halt before the scheduled rising edge delays it by the halt, so the TON times exactly as without one
notes: No debugger: the halt is run control through the reference plant's test hook (inject plugin). The schedule sets IN at 1000 ms of plant clock after the start; the halt covers wall 500-2500 ms. A plant on wall time sets IN during the halt, so the TON starts at resume and ET is about 1000 ms where this oracle expects 500. A152's two-log comparison (2 s against 0.3 s) is tests/debug/plant/e2e.sh.

steps.note: the clock, the scan count and the schedule all wait for the halt
IN rose at 1000 ms of virtual time, about 500 ms ago
